description: Build EnhancedGameCard component with social proof overlay and RecommendationCarousel with swipe gestures. Integrate into main games page.
steps: Create components/games-hub/enhanced-game-card.js: extend existing game card to add social_proof fields (friendsPlaying, spotFilledPercent, trendingIndicator, participantAvatars)
Display overlay badges: 'X friends playing', 'Spots filling fast' (if > 70% full), 'Trending' (if trendingIndicator true)
Show quick-peek player avatars (4-5 recent participants) and 'Players You Know' indicator
Create components/games-hub/recommendation-carousel.js with Framer Motion: fetch GET /api/recommendations/games on mount
Render 1 card on mobile, 3 cards on desktop (breakpoint-aware with CSS or dynamic state)
Implement swipe gesture (Framer Motion drag prop) for card navigation
Auto-rotate carousel: 5s interval, pause on user interaction
Error handling: show 'Check back later' if recommendations fail
Integrate both components into app/games/page.js: replace old cards with enhanced, add recommendation carousel between hero and games list
acceptance_criteria: EnhancedGameCard renders with all social_proof fields
Social proof badges displayed correctly (friends playing, trending, spots filling)
RecommendationCarousel shows 1 card on mobile, 3 on desktop
Swipe gesture works (drag card left/right changes visible cards)
Auto-rotate works: carousel advances card every 5s
Carousel pauses auto-rotate on user interaction
Error fallback renders if recommendations endpoint fails
verification: Load /games page, verify games displayed with social_proof badges
Scroll down, verify recommendation carousel visible below hero
On mobile (<640px), verify carousel shows 1 card at a time
On desktop (>1024px), verify carousel shows 3 cards
Drag/swipe card in carousel, verify next card appears
Wait 5s, verify carousel auto-rotates to next card
API error test: mock GET /api/recommendations to fail, verify fallback message
